<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Intelligence Report - Social Media Monitoring</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
        :root {
            --primary-dark: #0a1929;
            --secondary-dark: #1a3a5f;
            --accent-blue: #2563eb;
            --accent-green: #10b981;
            --accent-red: #ef4444;
            --accent-amber: #f59e0b;
            --light-gray: #f8fafc;
            --medium-gray: #e2e8f0;
            --dark-gray: #64748b;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--light-gray);
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        
        .sentiment-negative {
            background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }
        
        .sentiment-neutral {
            background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }
        
        .sentiment-positive {
            background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }
        
        .platform-twitter {
            border-left: 4px solid #1da1f2;
        }
        
        .platform-instagram {
            border-left: 4px solid #e1306c;
        }
        
        .platform-facebook {
            border-left: 4px solid #1877f2;
        }
        
        .platform-youtube {
            border-left: 4px solid #ff0000;
        }
        
        .platform-whatsapp {
            border-left: 4px solid #25d366;
        }
        
        .card-shadow {
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }
        
        .chart-bar {
            transition: height 0.5s ease;
        }
    </style>
</head>

Intelligence Summary

The monitored social media landscape shows a generally stable conversation around community safety topics. Negative sentiment appears to be primarily focused on procedural concerns rather than substantive threats. Positive engagement continues to be driven by community participation in safety initiatives.

Key indicators suggest continued community interest in collaborative safety measures, with minimal signs of escalating tensions or immediate threats. Ongoing monitoring is recommended to track evolving patterns in community engagement.
